initial:
Create ONE clean professional SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM PNG for a mobile web app. Render at the highest native resolution available, landscape 16:9, with sharp readable typography and accurate technical connections. This is a diagram, not an app screenshot or a brand moodboard.

STYLE: flat vector aesthetic, pure white background, soft rounded rectangles, thin connector arrows with short labels, generous margins. Palette: terracotta #C2552D for app component borders and light tints; warm sand #E9DCC6 for data storage; deep olive #4F5D2F for AI model boxes, with white lettering inside; charcoal #2B2B2B for other text. Readable contemporary sans-serif labels. No people, stock illustrations, 3D, gradients or decorative backgrounds. Only small simple outline icons if useful: phone, database, film strip, microphone, chat bubble. Accessibility and legibility take priority over decoration.

TOP:
Title exactly "Handful Recipes — Architecture"
Subtitle exactly "Video in → living family recipe out"

MAIN LAYOUT: Four clean aligned columns left to right. Allocate roughly 17% width to users, 28% to app, 32% to processing, 23% to models. Put headings clearly above their respective groups. Keep all text large enough to read at full diagram width. Model-call arrows route through a narrow gutter with elbow connectors and small numbered labels; do not draw through box text. User/app connectors on left, model calls on right. Preserve clear flow.

COLUMN 1 heading "Users", three simple rounded boxes:
"Family member (phone)" sublabel "records cooking video"
"Grandma (WhatsApp link)" sublabel "answers questions by voice note"
"Family (shared link)" sublabel "views the living recipe"
Connect Family member to Upload & Record with label "record / upload".
Connect Grandma to Answer Page with label "open link / reply".
Connect Family to Living Recipe Page with label "view".

COLUMN 2 heading two lines "App" and "(Next.js PWA on Vercel)", terracotta-accented rounded cards, vertical:
"Upload & Record"
"Review Draft" sublabel "steps, clips, highlighted gaps"
"Questions" sublabel "send via WhatsApp share link"
"Answer Page" sublabel "voice note, no install"
"Living Recipe Page" sublabel "steps + clips + answers"
Show Questions shares a link toward Grandma/Answer Page, label "share link", without implying WhatsApp Business API or a bot.
Upload & Record submits a job to the processing pipeline, arrow label "enqueue".
Answer Page sends new audio to pipeline step 6, label "new answer".
Pipeline output feeds Review Draft and Living Recipe Page using an unobtrusive returning connector labeled "draft / updates" rather than crossing text.
Do not imply that the long-running FFmpeg worker executes inside a Vercel request.

COLUMN 3 heading "Processing Pipeline" with subheading "(background worker)".
Six numbered rounded cards arranged in a vertical sequence with short down arrows:
1. "FFmpeg: extract audio + keyframes"
2. "Transcribe speech by speaker turn"
3. "Segment video into steps"
4. "Track hand / ingredient for 'handful' clips"
5. "Detect missing info → questions"
6. "Merge answers into recipe"
Use a small filled terracotta number circle on each card. Do not omit or reorder steps.

COLUMN 4 heading "Meta AI Models" and subheading "(Meta Model API)".
Four deep olive rounded boxes:
"Muse Voice Transcribe" sublabel "speech + diarization"
"Muse Spark 1.3" sublabel "video understanding, steps, gaps"
"SAM 3.1" sublabel "segmentation + video tracking"
"Muse Image (optional)" sublabel "recipe cover"
Clearly connect:
step 2 → Muse Voice Transcribe.
step 3 → Muse Spark 1.3.
step 4 → SAM 3.1.
step 5 → Muse Spark 1.3.
step 6 → Muse Voice Transcribe for voice-answer transcription, and step 6 → Muse Spark 1.3 for semantic merging.
Use connector labels "2, 6", "3, 5, 6", and "4" on grouped call paths where that improves clarity, but accurately show their step origins.
Step 1 is local FFmpeg and must NOT connect to an AI model.
Muse Image is optional, show dashed connector from the pipeline output labelled "optional cover"; do not invent a numbered processing step or use Muse Image for factual measurement.

BOTTOM ROW spanning diagram beneath main columns:
Group heading exactly "Data (Supabase)"
Two broad warm sand rounded boxes side by side:
"Postgres: recipes, steps, questions, answers"
"Storage: videos, clips, voice notes"
Short thin connectors from app and worker toward the data row, with labels "read / write" and "media". Keep storage separate from AI models.
At very bottom a subtle slim banner with exact small italic rule:
"Every step links to its source clip. Measurements are shown, never invented."

All labels must be spelled exactly as specified. Avoid excess tiny fine print. Use compact natural line breaks, strong alignment, wide whitespace and professional presentation quality. No company logos, no watermark.
